name: Hilda
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.

shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 170.63 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Hilda. No shape model is published.

introduction: J. Palisa found Hilda at Pola on 2 November 1875.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 170.63 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
